name: Path of the Wild Heart
summary: Rage with the spirits of beasts
description: A Barbarian who channels animal spirits, choosing a beast aspect each time they rage.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: You can cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.description: Each time you Rage, pick an animal aspect for that Rage: Bear (Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant), Eagle (Dash and Disengage as part of the Bonus Action, and as a Bonus Action later) or Wolf (allies have Advantage on attacks against enemies within 5 feet of you).

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.description: Pick one lasting benefit, changeable after a Long Rest: Owl (Darkvision 60 ft, or +60 ft), Panther (Climb Speed equal to your Speed) or Salmon (Swim Speed equal to your Speed).

options.name: Owl
options.description: Gain Darkvision 60 ft, or extend existing Darkvision by 60 ft.

options.name: Panther
options.description: Gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Salmon
options.description: Gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.description: You can cast Commune with Nature as a ritual, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.description: Each time you Rage, pick another aspect for that Rage: Falcon (Fly Speed equal to your Speed while unarmored), Lion (nearby enemies have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you) or Ram (your melee hits can knock Large or smaller foes Prone).

name: Path of the World Tree
summary: Draw on the cosmic tree that binds the planes
description: A Barbarian whose Rage taps the life force of the World Tree, shielding allies and pulling foes across space.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.description: Entering a Rage grants you Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level, and at the start of each of your raging turns you can give a nearby creature Temporary Hit Points (a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus).

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: While raging, you can use your Reaction when a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet; on a failed Strength save it is teleported next to you and its Speed drops to 0 for the turn.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.description: Your Heavy or Versatile melee weapons gain 10 extra feet of reach, and on a hit you can also apply the Push or Topple mastery property alongside the weapon's own.

features.name: Travel Along the Tree
features.description: When you Rage, and as a Bonus Action while raging, you can teleport up to 60 feet; once per Rage the jump can reach 150 feet and carry up to six willing creatures near you.

name: Path of the Zealot
summary: Rage in ecstatic union with a god
description: A Barbarian fueled by divine fury, hard to keep down and empowered by a deity.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: Once on each of your raging turns, the first creature you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike takes extra Necrotic or Radiant damage equal to 1d6 plus half your Barbarian level.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: You have a pool of d12s you can spend as a Bonus Action to heal yourself; the pool grows with level (4 dice at level 3, up to 7 at level 17) and refills on a Long Rest.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Once per Rage, when you fail a saving throw you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, up to ten creatures of your choice within 60 feet gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn; once per Long Rest, or spend a use of Rage to do it again.

features.name: Rage of the Gods
features.description: When you start a Rage you can take a divine form for 1 minute, gaining a Fly Speed, Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage, and a Reaction (costing a Rage use) to keep a dying creature nearby at Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level; once per Long Rest.

name: College of Dance
summary: Move in harmony with the cosmos
description: A Bard whose magic flows through dance, fighting unarmored with nimble, inspiration-fueled strikes.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.description: While unarmored and without a Shield: Advantage on dance-based Performance, AC equals 10 + Dex + Cha, you can make an Unarmed Strike when you spend Bardic Inspiration, and your Unarmed Strikes can use Dexterity and deal your Bardic Inspiration die plus Dex in Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: When an enemy ends its turn next to you, you can spend a Reaction and a Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed, and one ally nearby can also move half its Speed, without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.description: When you roll Initiative you can spend a Bardic Inspiration die; you and allies within 30 feet add the roll to Initiative.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: When you make a Dexterity save to halve damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure; creatures within 5 feet of you making the same save share the benefit.

name: College of Glamour
summary: Weave beguiling Feywild magic
description: A Bard trained in the Feywild's arts of enchantment, captivating allies and foes alike.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.description: You always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared; after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a slot, you can force a creature within 60 feet to save or be Charmed or Frightened for 1 minute (once per Long Rest, or spend a Bardic Inspiration to reuse).

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Bardic Inspiration die to give several nearby creatures Temporary Hit Points (twice the roll), and each can immediately use its Reaction to move without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: You always have Command prepared; as a Bonus Action you can cast it free and then, for 1 minute of Concentration, cast it again as a Bonus Action each turn (once per Long Rest, or spend a level 3+ slot).

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action you take on a majestic presence for 1 minute; the first time each turn a creature hits you, it must pass a Charisma save or the attack misses (once per Short or Long Rest).

name: College of Valor
summary: Sing the deeds of ancient heroes
description: A Bard who fights on the front line and inspires allies to martial heroics.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can add it to a weapon damage roll, or use its Reaction to add it to its AC against an attack that would hit it.

features.name: Martial Training
features.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields, and you can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a Spellcasting Focus.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can cast one of your action-time cantrips in place of one of those attacks.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: After you cast a spell with a casting time of an action, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

name: Light Domain
summary: Bring light to banish darkness
description: A Cleric devoted to gods of sun, fire and truth, wielding radiant power against darkness.

features.name: Light Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells listed for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity as a Magic action to dispel magical Darkness around you and force chosen creatures within 30 feet to make a Constitution save against 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant damage (half on success).

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet attacks, you can use your Reaction to give that attack Disadvantage; uses equal your Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.description: Warding Flare also recovers on a Short Rest, and the attack's target can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: As a Magic action you shine with sunlight for 1 minute; enemies in the bright light have Disadvantage on saves against your Radiance of the Dawn and your Fire or Radiant spells (uses equal your Wisdom modifier per Long Rest).

name: Trickery Domain
summary: Make mischief and challenge authority
description: A Cleric of trickster gods who deals in illusion, stealth and misdirection.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: As a Magic action you can give yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until your next Long Rest or until you use this again.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to create an illusory double of yourself for 1 minute; you can cast spells from its space, move it as a Bonus Action, and gain Advantage against creatures within 5 feet of both of you.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells listed for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.description: Whenever you create or move your illusory double, you can teleport to swap places with it.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: Your allies also gain Advantage against creatures near your double, and when the double ends you or a creature next to it can regain Hit Points equal to your Cleric level.

name: War Domain
summary: Inspire valor and smite foes
description: A Cleric of battle gods who fights in the front ranks and guides allies' blows.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet misses with an attack roll, spend Channel Divinity to add +10 to the roll (using your Reaction if it's someone else's attack).

features.name: War Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells listed for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: As a Bonus Action you can make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike; uses equal your Wisdom modifier and return on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: You can spend Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot; cast this way it needs no Concentration and lasts 1 minute.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

name: Circle of the Moon
summary: Adopt animal forms to guard the wilds
description: A Druid who masters Wild Shape, taking on powerful beast forms touched by moonlight.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: Your Wild Shape forms can have a Challenge Rating up to one-third of your Druid level; in a form your AC is at least 13 + Wis modifier and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to three times your Druid level.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
features.description: You always have the circle spells for your Druid level prepared, and you can cast them while in Wild Shape.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.description: In Wild Shape your attacks can deal Radiant damage instead of their normal type, and you add your Wisdom modifier to Constitution saving throws.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.description: As a Bonus Action you teleport up to 30 feet and gain Advantage on your next attack this turn; uses equal your Wisdom modifier per Long Rest, or spend a level 2+ slot.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.description: Once per turn your Wild Shape attacks can deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage, and Moonlight Step can bring a willing creature near you along.

name: Circle of the Sea
summary: Become one with tides and storms
description: A Druid who channels the fury of the ocean, wrapping themself in a churning aura of spray.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.description: You always have the circle spells for your Druid level prepared.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action to surround yourself with a 5-foot aura of ocean spray for 10 minutes; each turn you can force one creature in it to save or take Cold damage (d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier) and be pushed away.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: Your Wrath of the Sea aura grows to 10 feet, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: While Wrath of the Sea is active you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning and Thunder damage.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.description: You can manifest Wrath of the Sea around a willing ally instead of yourself, or spend two Wild Shape uses to wrap both of you.

name: Circle of the Stars
summary: Harness secrets hidden in constellations
description: A Druid who reads the heavens, taking starry forms and drawing omens from the night sky.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: You carry a star chart that serves as your focus; you always have Guidance and Guiding Bolt prepared and can cast Guiding Bolt without a slot a few times (Wisdom modifier) per Long Rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action to become luminous for 10 minutes in one constellation: Archer (Bonus Action radiant ranged attack), Chalice (extra healing when you heal with a slot) or Dragon (minimum 10 on Int/Wis checks and Concentration saves).

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: After each Long Rest you roll to get Weal or Woe; you can then use a Reaction a few times per rest to add or subtract 1d6 from a nearby creature's D20 Test.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: Archer and Chalice dice become 2d8, Dragon grants a hovering 20-foot Fly Speed, and you can switch constellation at the start of each turn.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: While in Starry Form you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

name: Battle Master
summary: Master sophisticated battle maneuvers
description: A Fighter who studies warfare as an art, fueling special maneuvers with Superiority Dice.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: You gain Superiority Dice (four d8s at level 3, five at 7, six at 15; refreshed on a Short or Long Rest) and learn maneuvers that spend them; maneuver save DC is 8 + Str or Dex modifier + Proficiency Bonus.

options.name: Ambush
options.description: Add a Superiority Die to a Stealth check or an Initiative roll.

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.description: Swap places with a willing creature next to you; one of you adds the die to AC until your next turn.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.description: Give up one of your attacks so an ally can use its Reaction to attack, adding the die to its damage.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.description: Add the die to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check.

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.description: On a hit, add the die to damage and the target must save or drop an item it holds.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.description: On a hit, add the die to damage; the next attack against the target by someone else has Advantage.

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.description: As a Bonus Action, Disengage and add the die to your AC until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.description: As a Bonus Action, gain Advantage on your next attack against a creature next to you and add the die to its damage.

options.name: Goading Attack
options.description: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target must save or have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.description: As a Bonus Action, Dash; if you move 5+ feet straight before a melee hit, add the die to damage.

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.description: On a hit, add the die to damage and let an ally use its Reaction to move without provoking from the target.

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.description: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target must save or be Frightened of you briefly.

options.name: Parry
options.description: When a melee attack hits you, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by the die plus your Str or Dex modifier.

options.name: Precision Attack
options.description: When you miss with an attack roll, add the die to the roll, possibly turning it into a hit.

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.description: On a hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target must save or be pushed up to 15 feet.

options.name: Rally
options.description: As a Bonus Action, an ally who can perceive you gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the die plus half your Fighter level.

options.name: Riposte
options.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use your Reaction to attack it, adding the die to damage.

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.description: After a melee hit, deal the die's damage to a second creature next to you that the attack roll would also hit.

options.name: Tactical Assessment
options.description: Add the die to a History, Insight or Investigation check.

options.name: Trip Attack
options.description: On a hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target must save or fall Prone.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools and one skill from the Fighter skill list.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: As a Bonus Action you learn a nearby creature's immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities; once per Long Rest, or spend a Superiority Die.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.description: Your Superiority Dice become d10s.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver you can roll a d8 instead of spending a Superiority Die.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
features.description: Your Superiority Dice become d12s.

name: Eldritch Knight
summary: Support combat skills with arcane magic
description: A Fighter who blends weapon mastery with wizard spells, binding weapons and casting between blows.

spellcasting.note: Prepares Wizard spells; changes one prepared spell on gaining a Fighter level. Uses its own third-caster slot table; counts as one-third levels for multiclass slots.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You learn Wizard cantrips and prepare Wizard spells (Intelligence), following the Eldritch Knight spellcasting table.

choice.note: Cantrips and prepared spells follow the subclass spellcasting.levels table.

features.name: War Bond
features.description: Through a ritual you bond with up to two weapons; you can't be disarmed of them and can summon one to your hand as a Bonus Action.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with casting a Wizard cantrip that takes an action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon, it has Disadvantage on the next save it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you use Action Surge, you can also teleport up to 30 feet.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace two attacks with casting a level 1 or 2 Wizard spell that takes an action.

name: Psi Warrior
summary: Augment physical might with psionic power
description: A Fighter who awakens psionic power, guarding allies with force fields and striking with telekinesis.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: You gain Psionic Energy Dice (count and size grow with level) used for Protective Field (Reaction to reduce damage to a nearby creature), Psionic Strike (extra Force damage on a hit) and Telekinetic Movement (move an object or willing creature); one die returns on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description: Psi-Powered Leap gives you a Bonus Action burst of flying, and your Psionic Strike can push the target or knock it Prone on a failed Strength save.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and you can spend a Psionic Energy Die at the start of your turn to end Charmed and Frightened effects on yourself.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you and several chosen creatures nearby gain Half Cover for 1 minute; once per Long Rest, or spend a Psionic Energy Die.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: You always have Telekinesis prepared and can cast it without a slot or components once per Long Rest (or by spending a die), and while concentrating on it you can make a weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

name: Warrior of Mercy
summary: Manipulate forces of life and death
description: A Monk who heals with one hand and harms with the other, carrying the tools of a healer.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Once per turn when your Unarmed Strike hits, you can spend 1 Focus Point to add Necrotic damage equal to a Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 1 Focus Point to restore Hit Points equal to a Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier; during Flurry of Blows you can swap one strike for this healing without spending Focus.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: You gain proficiency in Insight and Medicine and with the Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.description: Hand of Harm can also leave the target Poisoned until the end of your next turn, and Hand of Healing can also end Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows you can replace each strike with Hand of Healing without spending Focus, and you can apply Hand of Harm to one strike for free a limited number of times per Long Rest.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 5 Focus Points to restore to life a creature that died within the past day, with 4d10 + Wis modifier Hit Points; once per Long Rest.

name: Warrior of Shadow
summary: Harness shadow power for stealth and subterfuge
description: A Monk who moves through darkness, teleporting between shadows and striking unseen.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: You can spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness (you can see through it and move it), you gain Darkvision 60 ft (or +60 ft), and you know the Minor Illusion cantrip.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, you can teleport as a Bonus Action up to 60 feet to another shadowy space and gain Advantage on your next melee attack this turn.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.description: You can spend 1 Focus Point to ignore Shadow Step's lighting requirements, and you can make an Unarmed Strike right after teleporting.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: As a Magic action in dim light or darkness, spend 3 Focus Points to become Invisible and partly incorporeal for 1 minute, and use Flurry of Blows without spending Focus.

name: Warrior of the Elements
summary: Wield strikes and bursts of elemental power
description: A Monk who channels elemental energy through their strikes, reaching, pushing and pulling foes.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: At the start of your turn spend 1 Focus Point to attune for 10 minutes: your Unarmed Strikes gain 10 feet of reach, can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage, and can push or pull the target on a failed Strength save.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.description: You know the Elementalism cantrip, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 2 Focus Points to explode a 20-foot-radius sphere within 120 feet; creatures in it make a Dexterity save against three Martial Arts dice of elemental damage.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.description: While attuned you have a Fly Speed and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.description: While attuned you gain Resistance to a chosen element, Step of the Wind boosts your Speed and damages creatures you pass, and once per turn your Unarmed Strikes deal an extra die of elemental damage.

name: Oath of Glory
summary: Strive for the heights of heroism
description: A Paladin who believes they are destined for legendary deeds and pushes allies toward glory.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
features.description: You always have the oath spells for your Paladin level prepared.

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.description: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend Channel Divinity to share 2d8 + Paladin level Temporary Hit Points among creatures within 30 feet.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity to gain Advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics checks and longer jumps for 1 hour.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, and allies who enter or start their turn in your aura also gain 10 feet of Speed until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.description: When you or a creature near you is hit, use your Reaction to add your Charisma modifier to the target's AC; if the attack then misses, you can make a weapon attack against the attacker. Uses equal your Charisma modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.description: As a Bonus Action, for 10 minutes you have Advantage on Charisma checks, can turn one missed attack per turn into a hit, and can reroll failed saves with your Reaction; once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

name: Oath of the Ancients
summary: Preserve life and light in the world
description: A Paladin sworn to protect the beauty and vitality of nature against the forces of darkness.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
features.description: You always have the oath spells for your Paladin level prepared.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.description: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity to make spectral vines grab chosen creatures within 15 feet; each must pass a Strength save or be Restrained for up to 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when you would drop to 0 Hit Points you instead drop to three times your Paladin level; you also age slowly and can't be magically aged.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.description: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute you regain 10 HP each turn, can cast action-time Paladin spells and Channel Divinity as Bonus Actions, and nearby enemies have Disadvantage on saves against them; once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

name: Oath of Vengeance
summary: Punish evildoers at any cost
description: A Paladin dedicated to hunting down those who commit grievous wrongs.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
features.description: You always have the oath spells for your Paladin level prepared.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.description: When you take the Attack action, spend Channel Divinity to gain Advantage on attacks against one creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; if it drops to 0 HP you can move the vow to another target.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: When your Opportunity Attack hits, the target's Speed drops to 0 for the turn and you can move up to half your Speed without provoking.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: When the target of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your Reaction to make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.description: As a Bonus Action, for 10 minutes you have spectral wings (60-foot Fly Speed) and an aura that can frighten enemies, making attacks against them easier; once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

name: Beast Master
summary: Bond with a primal beast
description: A Ranger who fights alongside a magical primal companion of land, sea or sky.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description: You summon a primal beast (Land, Sea or Sky stat block) that acts on your turn; you command it with a Bonus Action or let it strike in place of one of your attacks, and you can revive or resummon it with magic.

options.name: Beast of the Land
options.description: Sturdy walker that can charge and knock foes down.

options.name: Beast of the Sea
options.description: Swimmer whose strike can grapple targets.

options.name: Beast of the Sky
options.description: Fragile flyer that strikes and darts away.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: When you command your beast with a Bonus Action it can also Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help, and its attacks can deal Force damage.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: Your beast makes two attacks when you command its Beast's Strike, and its hits can trigger your Hunter's Mark damage.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: When you cast a spell that targets only yourself, your beast can also be affected if it's within 30 feet.

name: Fey Wanderer
summary: Wield fey mirth and fury
description: A Ranger touched by the Feywild, blending charm with psychic strikes.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: Once per turn your weapon hits can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage (1d6 at level 11).

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
features.description: You always have the listed spells for your Ranger level prepared.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.description: You add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.description: You have Advantage on saves against being Charmed or Frightened, and when a nearby creature resists those effects you can use your Reaction to try to Charm or Frighten another creature.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: You can cast Summon Fey without a material component, once per Long Rest without a slot, and can choose to cast it without Concentration for a 1-minute duration.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.description: You can cast Misty Step without a slot a few times (Wisdom modifier) per Long Rest, bringing a willing adjacent creature along.

name: Gloom Stalker
summary: Draw on shadow magic to fight your foes
description: A Ranger at home in darkness, ambushing foes before they can react.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: You add your Wisdom modifier to Initiative, gain 10 feet of Speed on your first turn of combat, and a few times per Long Rest a weapon hit can deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage (once per turn).

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
features.description: You always have the listed spells for your Ranger level prepared.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: You gain Darkvision 60 ft (or +60 ft), and while in Darkness you are invisible to creatures that rely on Darkvision to see you.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or Intelligence or Charisma saves if you already have it).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Your Dread Ambusher psychic damage becomes 2d8, and when you deal it you can also make an extra attack against a nearby creature or frighten the target and those around it.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: When a creature attacks you, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage, then teleport up to 30 feet.

name: Arcane Trickster
summary: Enhance stealth with arcane spells
description: A Rogue who adds wizard magic to their bag of tricks, using an invisible spectral hand for mischief.

spellcasting.note: Prepares Wizard spells; knows Mage Hand in addition to the cantrip count. Third-caster slot table; counts as one-third levels for multiclass slots.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You learn Mage Hand plus Wizard cantrips and prepare Wizard spells (Intelligence), following the Arcane Trickster spellcasting table.

choice.note: Plus Mage Hand; further cantrips/prepared spells follow spellcasting.levels.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Your Mage Hand is invisible, can be cast as a Bonus Action, and can pick locks, disarm traps, stow or retrieve objects using your Sleight of Hand and Thieves' Tools.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: If you are Invisible when you cast a spell on a creature, it has Disadvantage on saves against that spell.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: When you use the Trip option of Cunning Strike, you can also trip a creature near your spectral hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: When a creature casts a spell that targets or includes you, you can use your Reaction to force a save; on a failure you negate the spell's effect on you and can cast it yourself for 8 hours. Once per Long Rest.

name: Assassin
summary: Practice the grim art of death
description: A Rogue trained in disguise, poison and the swift, lethal ambush.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: You have Advantage on Initiative, Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't acted yet in the first round, and your first-round Sneak Attacks on such creatures deal extra damage equal to your Rogue level.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.description: You gain a Disguise Kit and a Poisoner's Kit and proficiency with both.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: You can flawlessly mimic another person's voice and handwriting after studying them, and using Steady Aim no longer drops your Speed to 0.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.description: When you use the Poison option of Cunning Strike, the target also takes 2d6 Poison damage that ignores Resistance.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: When your Sneak Attack hits in the first round of combat, the target must pass a Constitution save or take double damage.

name: Soulknife
summary: Strike foes with psionic blades
description: A Rogue who manifests blades of psychic energy and slips into others' minds.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: You gain Psionic Energy Dice to boost failed skill or tool checks (Psi-Bolstered Knack) and to open telepathic links with several creatures (Psychic Whispers); dice refresh partly on Short Rests and fully on Long Rests.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: You can manifest shimmering blades when you attack: finesse, thrown (60/120) simple weapons dealing 1d6 Psychic damage with the Vex mastery, plus a Bonus Action 1d4 off-hand blade.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description: Spend Psionic Energy Dice to add to a missed Psychic Blade attack (Homing Strikes) or to throw a blade and teleport to where it lands (Psychic Teleportation).

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: As a Magic action you become Invisible for up to 1 hour, ending early if you deal damage or force a save; once per Long Rest, or spend a die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: When your Psychic Blades deal Sneak Attack damage, the target must pass a Wisdom save or be Stunned for up to 1 minute; once per Long Rest, or spend three dice.

name: Aberrant Sorcery
summary: Wield unnatural psionic power
description: A Sorcerer whose power comes from an alien influence, granting telepathy and psionic magic.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: You always have the listed psionic spells for your Sorcerer level prepared; on gaining a level you may swap one for a Sorcerer Divination or Enchantment spell of the same level.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: As a Bonus Action you link telepathically with a creature within 30 feet for a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level, even across miles (Charisma modifier).

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: You can cast your Psionic Spells by spending Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level instead of a slot, and without Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves against being Charmed or Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend Sorcery Points to transform for 10 minutes, choosing a benefit per point: swimming and water breathing, hovering flight, seeing the Invisible, or squeezing through tiny gaps.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: As a Magic action you teleport up to 120 feet; creatures near where you left take 3d10 Force damage and are pulled toward that spot on a failed Strength save. Once per Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points.

name: Clockwork Sorcery
summary: Channel cosmic forces of order
description: A Sorcerer infused with the order of Mechanus, smoothing chaos and warding allies.

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.description: You always have the listed spells for your Sorcerer level prepared; on gaining a level you may swap one for a Sorcerer Abjuration or Transmutation spell of the same level.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: When a creature within 60 feet is about to roll with Advantage or Disadvantage, you can use your Reaction to cancel it; uses equal your Charisma modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 1–5 Sorcery Points to give a creature a ward of that many d8s, which it can spend to reduce damage it takes.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute attacks against you can't gain Advantage and your D20 Tests treat a roll of 9 or lower as 10; once per Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.description: As a Magic action, summon spirits of order in a 30-foot cube that heal up to 100 HP among creatures, repair objects and end spells of level 6 or lower; once per Long Rest, or 7 Sorcery Points.

name: Wild Magic Sorcery
summary: Unleash chaotic magic
description: A Sorcerer whose magic comes from raw chaos, sometimes surging with unpredictable effects.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, roll a d20; on a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table for a random magical effect.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Gain Advantage on one D20 Test before rolling; it recharges on a Long Rest, or automatically when you next cast a slotted Sorcerer spell (which triggers a surge).

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: When another creature you can see makes a D20 Test, spend 1 Sorcery Point and your Reaction to add or subtract 1d4 from the roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and choose either result.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.description: Once per Long Rest, right after casting a slotted Sorcerer spell, you can choose a surge effect from the table instead of rolling.

name: Archfey Patron
summary: Bargain with whimsical fey
description: A Warlock bound to a lord or lady of the Feywild, blinking around the battlefield with fey tricks.

features.name: Archfey Spells
features.description: You always have the patron spells for your Warlock level prepared.

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.description: You can cast Misty Step without a slot a few times (Charisma modifier) per Long Rest, adding either Refreshing Step (temporary HP) or Taunting Step (nearby foes have Disadvantage attacking others).

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: You can cast Misty Step as a Reaction when you take damage, and Steps of the Fey gains Disappearing Step (brief invisibility) and Dreadful Step (psychic damage around you).

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: You are immune to being Charmed, and when a creature hits you, your Reaction can halve the damage and turn some of it back on the attacker as Psychic damage; once per Long Rest, or spend a Pact slot.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.description: Right after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a slot, you can cast Misty Step for free as part of that action.

name: Celestial Patron
summary: Call on the power of the heavens
description: A Warlock pledged to a being of the Upper Planes, wielding healing light and radiant fire.

features.name: Celestial Spells
features.description: You always have the patron spells for your Warlock level prepared.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: You have a pool of d6s (1 + Warlock level) that you can spend as a Bonus Action to heal a creature within 60 feet, a few dice at a time; it refills on a Long Rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: You have Resistance to Radiant damage, and once per turn you add your Charisma modifier to the Radiant or Fire damage of one of your spells.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: Whenever you use Magical Cunning or finish a rest, you and up to five allies gain Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: When you or an ally nearby is about to make a Death Saving Throw, you can instead restore half their Hit Points, stand them up and blast and blind nearby enemies with radiant light; once per Long Rest.

name: Great Old One Patron
summary: Unearth forbidden lore of ineffable beings
description: A Warlock bound to an alien entity from beyond, gaining telepathy and mind-bending magic.

features.name: Great Old One Spells
features.description: You always have the patron spells for your Warlock level prepared.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: As a Bonus Action you link telepathically with a creature within 30 feet for minutes equal to your Warlock level, at a range of miles equal to your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.description: Your damaging Warlock spells can deal Psychic damage instead, and you can cast Warlock Enchantment and Illusion spells without Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.description: When you form a telepathic link, the creature must pass a Wisdom save or, while linked, have Disadvantage attacking you while you have Advantage attacking it; once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a Pact slot.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.description: You always have Hex prepared, and its target also has Disadvantage on saves of the ability you chose.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Your thoughts can't be read without your permission, you have Resistance to Psychic damage, and creatures that deal Psychic damage to you take the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: When you cast Summon Aberration it needs no Concentration, the creature gains Temporary Hit Points, and its hits deal extra Psychic damage.

name: Abjurer
summary: Shield companions and banish foes
description: A Wizard specializing in protective magic, wrapping themself in a resilient arcane ward.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Add two Abjuration spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free, and one more each time you gain a new spell-slot level.

choice.note: Added to your spellbook free; add one more abjuration spell each time you gain a new spell-slot level.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot creates a ward with HP equal to twice your Wizard level + Int modifier that absorbs damage you take; further Abjuration casts or spent slots recharge it.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, you can use your Reaction to have your Arcane Ward absorb it.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.description: You always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared, can cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action with your Proficiency Bonus added, and don't lose the slot if either fails.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: You have Advantage on saves against spells and Resistance to the damage of spells.

name: Diviner
summary: Learn the secrets of the multiverse
description: A Wizard who peers into the future, bending fate with foreseen dice rolls.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Add two Divination spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free, and one more each time you gain a new spell-slot level.

choice.note: Added to your spellbook free; add one more divination spell each time you gain a new spell-slot level.

features.name: Portent
features.description: After each Long Rest roll two d20s and keep them; you can replace any D20 Test made by you or a creature you can see with one of these rolls (once per turn).

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: When you cast a Divination spell of level 2+ with a slot, you regain an expended slot of a lower level (max level 5).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: As a Bonus Action gain one benefit until your next rest: Darkvision 120 ft, reading any language, or casting See Invisibility without a slot; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: You roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.

name: Illusionist
summary: Weave subtle spells of deception
description: A Wizard who crafts illusions so convincing they can briefly become real.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Add two Illusion spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free, and one more each time you gain a new spell-slot level.

choice.note: Added to your spellbook free; add one more illusion spell each time you gain a new spell-slot level.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.description: You cast Illusion spells without Verbal components, their ranges grow by 60 feet, and you know Minor Illusion, which you can cast as a Bonus Action creating both a sound and an image.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.description: You always have Summon Beast and Summon Fey prepared, can cast them as Illusion spells, and once per Long Rest each can be cast without a slot as a spectral version with half Hit Points.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, your Reaction interposes an illusory double so the attack misses; once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a level 2+ slot.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: When you cast an Illusion spell with a slot, you can make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute (it can't deal damage or impose conditions).

name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
summary: Call on ancestral spirits to protect allies
description: A Barbarian whose Rage summons ancestor spirits that hinder foes and shield companions.

features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.description: While raging, the first creature you hit each turn has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you, and others it hits have Resistance to its damage, until your next turn.

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.description: While raging, use your Reaction to reduce damage to an ally within 30 feet by 2d6 (3d6 at 10, 4d6 at 14).

features.name: Consult the Spirits
features.description: Cast Augury or Clairvoyance without a slot or components once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Vengeful Ancestors
features.description: When Spirit Shield reduces damage, the attacker takes Force damage equal to the amount prevented.

name: Path of the Storm Herald
summary: Rage as a living storm
description: A Barbarian whose Rage manifests as a storm aura shaped by desert, sea or tundra.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.description: While raging you emit a 10-foot aura tied to your chosen environment: desert (fire damage to nearby creatures), sea (lightning bolt at one creature) or tundra (temporary HP to allies); reactivate it as a Bonus Action.

options.name: Desert
options.description: Fire-themed aura; Fire resistance later.

options.name: Sea
options.description: Lightning-themed aura; Lightning resistance later.

options.name: Tundra
options.description: Cold-themed aura; Cold resistance later.

features.name: Storm Soul
features.description: You gain Resistance matching your environment (Fire, Lightning or Cold) plus a minor environmental benefit.

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.description: Creatures of your choice in your aura gain the same damage Resistance as you.

features.name: Raging Storm
features.description: Your aura gains a Reaction effect tied to your environment, such as burning an attacker, knocking a foe Prone or freezing a creature's movement.

name: Path of the Beast
summary: Unleash the beast within
description: A Barbarian whose Rage transforms their body, sprouting natural weapons.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.description: When you rage you grow a natural weapon of your choice for that Rage: Bite (heals you a little), Claws (an extra claw attack) or Tail (reach weapon and a Reaction to boost AC).

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.description: Your natural weapons count as magical, and after each rest you choose swimming, climbing or improved jumping.

options.name: Swimming
options.description: Swim Speed and water breathing.

options.name: Climbing
options.description: Climb Speed, even on ceilings.

options.name: Jumping
options.description: Extra jump distance when you jump.

features.name: Infectious Fury
features.description: When your natural weapon hits, the target must pass a Wisdom save or be forced to attack another creature or take 2d12 Psychic damage; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.description: When you Rage, willing allies nearby gain extra damage once per turn, and you gain temporary HP for each; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

name: Path of Wild Magic
summary: Rage awakens unpredictable magic
description: A Barbarian whose Rage unleashes random surges of wild magic.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.description: As an action, sense spells and magic items within 60 feet; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Wild Surge
features.description: When you enter a Rage, roll on the Wild Magic table for a random magical effect that lasts the Rage.

features.name: Bolstering Magic
features.description: Touch a creature to grant a d3 bonus to attacks and checks for 10 minutes, or restore a low-level spell slot; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.description: When you take damage or fail a save while raging, use your Reaction to reroll your Wild Surge.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.description: When you roll on the Wild Magic table, roll twice and choose.

name: College of Eloquence
summary: Persuade with peerless oratory
description: A Bard who wields words as weapons, rarely failing to persuade.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.description: On Persuasion and Deception checks, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract its roll from a creature's next saving throw.

features.name: Unfailing Inspiration
features.description: When a creature adds your Bardic Inspiration and still fails, it keeps the die.

features.name: Universal Speech
features.description: As an action, several creatures within 60 feet can understand you regardless of language for 1 hour; once per Long Rest or spend a slot.

features.name: Infectious Inspiration
features.description: When a creature succeeds using your Bardic Inspiration, you can use your Reaction to give another creature a die for free; uses equal Charisma modifier per Long Rest.

name: College of Creation
summary: Sing the Song of Creation
description: A Bard who channels the primordial song of creation to make objects and animate them.

features.name: Mote of Potential
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration dice gain an extra effect depending on use: ability checks roll twice, attacks cause a thunder burst, and saves grant temporary HP.

features.name: Performance of Creation
features.description: As an action, create a nonmagical item of limited value that lasts for a few hours; once per Long Rest or spend a level 2+ slot.

features.name: Animating Performance
features.description: As an action, animate a Large or smaller nonmagical item as a dancing item ally for 1 hour; once per Long Rest or spend a level 3+ slot.

features.name: Creative Crescendo
features.description: Performance of Creation can create several items at once, one of any size, without the value limit.

name: College of Swords
summary: Dazzle with deadly bladework
description: A Bard who performs feats of daring swordplay, flourishing with Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain Medium armor and scimitar proficiency, and can use a melee weapon you're proficient with as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description: When you take the Attack action your Speed increases by 10 feet, and on a hit you can spend Bardic Inspiration for a Defensive, Slashing or Mobile flourish that adds damage plus a defensive, cleaving or pushing effect.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.description: You can roll a d6 for a flourish instead of spending Bardic Inspiration.

name: College of Whispers
summary: Wield secrets and fear
description: A Bard who uses knowledge and terror as weapons, stealing the shadows of the dead.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Once per turn on a weapon hit, spend Bardic Inspiration to deal extra Psychic damage (2d6, rising to 8d6 at level 15).

features.name: Words of Terror
features.description: After a minute speaking privately with a creature, it must pass a Wisdom save or be Frightened for 1 hour; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Mantle of Whispers
features.description: When a humanoid dies near you, capture its shadow to disguise yourself as that person for 1 hour; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Shadow Lore
features.description: As an action, a creature must pass a Wisdom save or be Charmed for 8 hours, believing you know its darkest secret; once per Long Rest.

name: Twilight Domain
summary: Guard against the terrors of the night
description: A Cleric of dusk and rest who protects allies in a soothing twilight aura.

features.name: Twilight Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.description: You have Darkvision out to 300 feet and can share it briefly with several allies; sharing is once per Long Rest or costs a slot.

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.description: As an action, give a creature Advantage on its next Initiative roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.description: Create a 30-foot twilight aura for 1 minute; creatures ending their turn in it can gain temporary HP or shake off Charmed or Frightened.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.description: In dim light or darkness, gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute as a Bonus Action; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn your weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 Radiant damage (2d8 at level 14).

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.description: You and allies in your Twilight Sanctuary have Half Cover.

name: Grave Domain
summary: Watch over the line between life and death
description: A Cleric who guards the boundary of death, aiding the dying and destroying the undead.

features.name: Grave Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.description: Healing a creature at 0 HP uses maximum dice, and you can cast Spare the Dying as a Bonus Action at range.

features.name: Eyes of the Grave
features.description: As an action, sense undead within 60 feet; uses equal your Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
features.description: Curse a creature so it is vulnerable to the next attack that hits it.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.description: Use your Reaction to turn a critical hit against you or a nearby ally into a normal hit; uses equal Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Cleric cantrips.

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.description: When an enemy dies nearby, you or an ally can regain HP equal to its number of Hit Dice (once per round).

name: Forge Domain
summary: Craft wonders in the divine forge
description: A Cleric of smith gods who blesses arms and armor and stands unshaken in heavy plate.

features.name: Forge Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with Heavy armor and Smith's Tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.description: After a Long Rest, touch a weapon or suit of armor to give it a +1 bonus until your next Long Rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.description: Through a 1-hour ritual, craft a metal item of modest value.

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.description: You have Fire resistance and +1 AC while wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn your weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 Fire damage (2d8 at level 14).

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.description: You are immune to Fire damage and, in heavy armor, resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

name: Order Domain
summary: Enforce law and command obedience
description: A Cleric who embodies divine law, empowering allies' strikes through commanding magic.

features.name: Order Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain Heavy armor proficiency and either Intimidation or Persuasion.

features.name: Voice of Authority
features.description: When you cast a level 1+ spell on an ally, that ally can use its Reaction to make a weapon attack.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
features.description: Chosen creatures within 30 feet must pass a Wisdom save or be Charmed until your next turn and drop what they hold.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law
features.description: Cast level 1+ Enchantment spells as a Bonus Action; uses equal Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn your weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 Psychic damage (2d8 at level 14).

features.name: Order's Wrath
features.description: After you deal Divine Strike damage, the target is cursed so the next ally hit on it deals an extra 2d8 Psychic damage.

name: Peace Domain
summary: Bind allies together in harmony
description: A Cleric of harmony who links companions with protective, empowering bonds.

features.name: Peace Domain Spells
features.description: You always have the domain spells for your Cleric level prepared.

features.name: Implement of Peace
features.description: You gain proficiency in Insight, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Emboldening Bond
features.description: Bond several creatures for 10 minutes; while near another bonded creature, each can add 1d4 to one roll per turn. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
features.description: Move up to your speed without provoking, healing each creature you pass close to.

features.name: Protective Bond
features.description: When a bonded creature is about to take damage, another bonded creature can teleport next to it with its Reaction and take the damage instead.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Cleric cantrips.

features.name: Expansive Bond
features.description: Bond benefits work at 60 feet, and a creature taking damage through Protective Bond has Resistance to it.

name: Circle of Spores
summary: Find beauty in decay
description: A Druid who embraces fungus and rot, wreathed in necrotic spores and animating the fallen.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: You always have the circle spells for your Druid level prepared, plus the Chill Touch cantrip.

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.description: Use your Reaction to deal Necrotic damage (1d4, scaling with level) to a creature within 10 feet that fails a Constitution save.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.description: Spend Wild Shape to gain 4 temporary HP per Druid level, doubling Halo damage and adding Necrotic damage to your melee hits while the temporary HP last.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.description: When a nearby beast or humanoid dies, use your Reaction to animate it as a 1-HP zombie for 1 hour; uses equal Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.description: While Symbiotic Entity is active, hurl spores into a 10-foot cube that deals your Halo damage to creatures there.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.description: You are immune to Blinded, Deafened, Frightened and Poisoned, and critical hits against you count as normal hits.

name: Circle of Wildfire
summary: Burn away the old to make way for the new
description: A Druid bonded to a wildfire spirit that both scorches and heals.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: You always have the circle spells for your Druid level prepared.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.description: Spend Wild Shape to summon a fiery spirit companion that burns creatures where it appears and can teleport allies.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.description: While your spirit is present, add 1d8 to your Fire damage or healing spells, and your spells can originate from the spirit.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.description: When a creature dies near you or the spirit, a flame lingers that you can use to heal or burn a creature that enters it.

features.name: Blazing Revival
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when you drop to 0 HP your spirit can sacrifice itself to restore you to half your HP.

name: Circle of Dreams
summary: Draw on the healing dreams of the Feywild
description: A Druid tied to the Feywild's dreamlike magic, healing allies and slipping along hidden paths.

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.description: You have a pool of d6s (equal to Druid level) that you can spend as a Bonus Action to heal a distant creature and grant it temporary HP.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.description: During a rest you create a sheltering sphere that conceals and protects those inside.

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.description: Teleport yourself as a Bonus Action or a willing ally as an action a short distance; uses equal Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.description: After a Short Rest, cast Dream, Scrying or Teleportation Circle (to a place you rested) once per Long Rest without a slot.

name: Circle of the Shepherd
summary: Commune with nature spirits and protect beasts
description: A Druid who calls guardian spirits and empowers summoned creatures.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.description: You learn Sylvan and can understand and be understood by beasts.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.description: As a Bonus Action, summon a Bear, Hawk or Unicorn spirit aura for 1 minute that grants temporary HP, attack Advantage, or extra healing; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.description: Beasts and fey you summon gain extra HP per Hit Die and magical natural attacks.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.description: Summoned creatures that end their turn in your Spirit Totem aura regain HP.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when you drop to 0 HP or are incapacitated, four protective beasts appear to guard you.

name: Rune Knight
summary: Empower your gear with giant runes
description: A Fighter who carves giant runes into their equipment and can swell to giant size.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with Smith's Tools and learn the Giant language.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.description: Inscribe runes on your gear, each with a passive benefit and an invocable effect (once per Short or Long Rest each).

options.name: Cloud Rune
options.description: Better at trickery; invoke to redirect an attack that hits a nearby creature to another target.

options.name: Fire Rune
options.description: Better with tools; invoke on a hit to shackle the target in fiery bonds (Restrained, ongoing Fire damage).

options.name: Frost Rune
options.description: Better at intimidation; invoke to boost your Strength and Constitution checks and saves for 10 minutes.

options.name: Stone Rune
options.description: Grants Darkvision and insight; invoke to charm a foe into a dreamy stupor.

options.name: Hill Rune
options.description: Resist poison; invoke to resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for 1 minute.

options.name: Storm Rune
options.description: You can't be surprised; invoke for a prophetic state that grants Advantage or Disadvantage on nearby rolls.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.description: As a Bonus Action become Large for 1 minute, gaining Advantage on Strength checks and saves and extra damage once per turn; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.description: When an ally within 60 feet is hit, use your Reaction to force the attacker to reroll; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Great Stature
features.description: You grow permanently taller and Giant's Might extra damage increases to 1d8.

features.name: Master of Runes
features.description: Each rune can be invoked twice per rest.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut
features.description: Giant's Might can make you Huge, adds reach, and its extra damage becomes 1d10.

name: Samurai
summary: Fight with indomitable spirit
description: A Fighter of unshakable resolve who channels fighting spirit into a flurry of strikes.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency in History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or learn one language.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.description: As a Bonus Action gain Advantage on weapon attacks this turn and some temporary HP; three uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to Persuasion checks and gain Wisdom save proficiency (or Int or Cha if already proficient).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.description: If you have no Fighting Spirit uses when you roll Initiative, you regain one.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.description: Once per turn, give up Advantage on one attack to make an extra attack.

features.name: Strength before Death
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when reduced to 0 HP you can immediately take an extra turn before falling.

name: Echo Knight
summary: Fight alongside an echo from another timeline
description: A Fighter who summons a shadowy echo of themself from an alternate reality to strike and swap places.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.description: As a Bonus Action summon a fragile echo of yourself nearby; you can attack from its space and swap places with it.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.description: When you take the Attack action, make one extra attack from your echo's position; uses equal Constitution modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.description: Perceive through your echo for up to 10 minutes while it scouts far away.

features.name: Shadow Martyr
features.description: Teleport your echo in front of an attack aimed at another creature so the echo is hit instead; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.description: When your echo is destroyed, gain temporary HP; uses equal Constitution modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Legion of One
features.description: You can have two echoes at once, and regain an Unleash Incarnation use when you roll Initiative with none left.

name: Arcane Archer
summary: Weave magic into arrows
description: A Fighter who imbues arrows with elven arcane effects.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.description: Gain proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and learn Prestidigitation or Druidcraft.

options.name: Prestidigitation
options.description: Minor arcane tricks.

options.name: Druidcraft
options.description: Minor nature tricks.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.description: Twice per Short or Long Rest, when you hit with a bow, apply a known Arcane Shot effect.

options.name: Banishing Arrow
options.description: Target may be briefly banished to the Feywild.

options.name: Beguiling Arrow
options.description: Psychic damage and the target may be charmed by an ally.

options.name: Bursting Arrow
options.description: Force damage bursts around the target.

options.name: Enfeebling Arrow
options.description: Necrotic damage that can halve the target's weapon damage.

options.name: Grasping Arrow
options.description: Poison damage and thorny brambles that slow and hurt the target.

options.name: Piercing Arrow
options.description: The arrow passes through a line of creatures.

options.name: Seeking Arrow
options.description: Homes in on a known target, ignoring most cover, and reveals its location.

options.name: Shadow Arrow
options.description: Psychic damage that can limit the target's sight.

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.description: Nonmagical arrows you fire count as magical.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.description: As a Bonus Action, redirect a missed magic arrow at a different target within 60 feet.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.description: Regain one Arcane Shot use when you roll Initiative with none left.

features.name: Improved Shots
features.description: Your Arcane Shot effects deal more damage.

name: Cavalier
summary: Charge and protect from the saddle
description: A Fighter who excels at mounted combat and at locking down foes to protect allies.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency in Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or learn one language.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.description: You are hard to dismount and can mount or dismount quickly.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.description: Creatures you hit are marked, hindering their attacks on others and letting you punish them with a bonus attack.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.description: Use your Reaction to add 1d8 to your or an adjacent ally's AC against an attack, reducing damage if it still hits.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks from you by moving within your reach, and your hits stop their movement.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.description: After moving 10 feet straight, a hit can knock the target Prone.

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.description: You get a special Reaction for Opportunity Attacks on every other creature's turn.

name: Way of the Kensei
summary: Perfect the art of a chosen weapon
description: A Monk who treats chosen weapons as extensions of their body.

features.name: Path of the Kensei
features.description: Choose two kensei weapons (more at later levels) that count as monk weapons, gain an AC boost after unarmed hits, bonus ranged damage, and calligrapher's or painter's supplies.

features.name: One with the Blade
features.description: Kensei weapons count as magical, and you can spend ki for extra damage once per turn.

features.name: Sharpen the Blade
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend up to 3 ki to give a kensei weapon a matching attack and damage bonus for 1 minute.

features.name: Unerring Accuracy
features.description: Once per turn, reroll a missed monk weapon attack.

name: Way of the Drunken Master
summary: Fight with unpredictable, swaying grace
description: A Monk whose staggering movements confuse and redirect foes.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Performance and with Brewer's Supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.description: Flurry of Blows also grants the Disengage benefit and extra speed.

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.description: Stand from Prone cheaply, and spend ki to redirect a missed attack onto another creature next to you.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.description: Spend ki to cancel Disadvantage on a roll.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.description: Flurry of Blows can include several extra attacks, each against a different creature.

name: Way of the Astral Self
summary: Manifest your astral self
description: A Monk who summons spectral arms and a visage of their true astral form.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self
features.description: Spend ki to summon astral arms that strike with reach, use Wisdom and deal Force damage.

features.name: Visage of the Astral Self
features.description: Spend ki to don an astral visage granting long-range sight in darkness and social advantages.

features.name: Body of the Astral Self
features.description: With arms and visage manifested, you can deflect energy damage and add a Martial Arts die to one hit per turn.

features.name: Awakened Astral Self
features.description: Spend ki to manifest your whole astral self, gaining AC and an extra attack with the astral arms.

name: Oath of Conquest
summary: Crush enemies through fear and might
description: A Paladin who seeks victory through domination, paralyzing foes with dread.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: You always have the oath spells for your Paladin level prepared.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Conquering Presence frightens nearby creatures; Guided Strike adds +10 to an attack roll.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.description: Frightened enemies in your aura can't move and take Psychic damage each turn.

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.description: Creatures that hit you take Psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.description: Once per Long Rest, for 1 minute you resist all damage, attack extra and score critical hits more easily.

name: Oath of Redemption
summary: Offer peace before the sword
description: A Paladin who seeks to redeem the wicked, punishing violence while protecting others.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: You always have the oath spells for your Paladin level prepared.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Emissary of Peace boosts Persuasion; Rebuke the Violent punishes a creature that just harmed someone with radiant damage.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.description: Use your Reaction to take the damage meant for an ally in your aura.

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.description: At the end of your turn, regain some HP if you're below half.

features.name: Emissary of Redemption
features.description: You resist damage from creatures, and attackers take radiant damage back until you attack them.

name: Oath of the Watchers
summary: Guard the mortal realm from extraplanar threats
description: A Paladin who stands watch against aberrations, fiends and other invaders from beyond.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: You always have the oath spells for your Paladin level prepared.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Watcher's Will grants allies Advantage on mental saves; Abjure the Extraplanar turns otherworldly creatures.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.description: You and creatures in your aura add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative.

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke
features.description: When you or an ally succeeds on a mental save, the creature that forced it takes Force damage.

features.name: Mortal Bulwark
features.description: Once per Long Rest, gain Truesight and Advantage against extraplanar creatures, and your hits can banish them.

name: Horizon Walker
summary: Guard the boundaries between planes
description: A Ranger who hunts planar threats and steps between worlds.

features.name: Horizon Walker Magic
features.description: You always have the listed spells for your Ranger level prepared.

features.name: Detect Portal
features.description: Sense the direction and distance of the nearest planar portal within a mile; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.description: As a Bonus Action mark a creature; your next hit on it this turn deals Force damage plus 1d8 (2d8 at 11).

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.description: As a Bonus Action step into the Ethereal Plane until the end of your turn; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Distant Strike
features.description: Teleport a short distance before each attack, gaining an extra attack if you strike two different creatures.

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.description: Use your Reaction to gain Resistance to an attack's damage.

name: Monster Slayer
summary: Hunt creatures of dark magic
description: A Ranger dedicated to tracking and destroying supernatural monsters.

features.name: Monster Slayer Magic
features.description: You always have the listed spells for your Ranger level prepared.

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.description: Learn a creature's immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities; uses equal Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.description: As a Bonus Action mark a creature; your first hit on it each turn deals an extra 1d6.

features.name: Supernatural Defense
