features.description: Add 1d6 to saves and grapple escapes caused by your prey.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.description: Use your Reaction to try to foil a creature's spell or teleport; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.description: When your prey forces you to save, use your Reaction to attack it; a hit makes you succeed automatically.

name: Swarmkeeper
summary: Command a swarm of nature spirits
description: A Ranger accompanied by a swarm of tiny spirits that nudge, sting and carry.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.description: You know Mage Hand and always have the listed spells for your Ranger level prepared.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.description: Once per turn on a hit, your swarm deals extra piercing damage, pushes the target, or moves you a short distance.

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.description: As a Bonus Action your swarm lifts you to hover with a small Fly Speed for 1 minute; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Mighty Swarm
features.description: Gathered Swarm grows stronger, can knock targets Prone, and shields you with cover when it moves you.

features.name: Swarming Dispersal
features.description: When you take damage, use your Reaction to resist it and teleport away; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

name: Swashbuckler
summary: Duel with flair and audacity
description: A Rogue who fights with daring panache in one-on-one duels.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: After you make a melee attack against a creature, it can't make Opportunity Attacks against you this turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: Add your Charisma modifier to Initiative, and Sneak Attack a lone adjacent foe without needing Advantage.

features.name: Panache
features.description: Use Persuasion against a creature's Insight to taunt a foe into focusing on you or charm a non-hostile creature.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.description: As a Bonus Action gain Advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, reroll a missed attack with Advantage.

name: Phantom
summary: Walk with the spirits of the dead
description: A Rogue haunted by spirits, borrowing their skills and channeling necrotic wails.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.description: After each rest, gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice until your next rest.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.description: After dealing Sneak Attack, a second nearby creature takes Necrotic damage; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.description: When a creature dies nearby, create a soul trinket that bolsters your saves and can fuel Wails or answer questions.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.description: As a Bonus Action take a spectral form for 10 minutes: slow flight, harder to hit, and passing through objects; once per Long Rest or destroy a trinket.

features.name: Death's Friend
features.description: Wails from the Grave also hurts your Sneak Attack target, and you always regain a trinket after a Long Rest if you have none.

name: Mastermind
summary: Manipulate people and battles from the shadows
description: A Rogue of intrigue who aids allies from afar and reads opponents.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.description: Gain proficiency with disguise and forgery kits and one gaming set, learn two languages, and mimic speech patterns.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: Take the Help action as a Bonus Action, and help an ally attack a creature up to 30 feet away.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.description: Studying a creature for a minute reveals how its mental stats and level compare to yours.

features.name: Misdirection
features.description: When attacked while a creature next to you gives you cover, use your Reaction to make the attack hit that creature.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.description: Your thoughts can't be read, you can project false thoughts, and magic can't reveal your lies.

name: Scout
summary: Range ahead as a skirmisher and survivalist
description: A Rogue who excels at scouting, moving quickly and striking from ambush.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.description: When an enemy ends its turn next to you, use your Reaction to move half your speed without provoking.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: Gain proficiency and Expertise in Nature and Survival.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.description: Your walking, climbing and swimming speeds increase by 10 feet.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.description: Advantage on Initiative, and the first creature you hit in round one is easier for allies to hit.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.description: Make a bonus attack when you take the Attack action, and Sneak Attack can apply again against a different target.

name: Inquisitive
summary: Root out secrets and lies
description: A Rogue detective with a sharp eye for lies, details and weaknesses.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.description: When you use Insight to detect lies, a low d20 roll counts as 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: Make Perception or Investigation checks as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.description: As a Bonus Action, read a foe with Insight to Sneak Attack it without Advantage for 1 minute.

features.name: Steady Eye
features.description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation if you move no more than half speed.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.description: Sense illusions and shapechangers nearby; uses equal Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.description: Your Sneak Attack deals extra damage to the target of Insightful Fighting.

name: Shadow Magic
summary: Draw on the power of the Shadowfell
description: A Sorcerer touched by the Shadowfell, cheating death and stepping through darkness.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.description: You have long-range Darkvision, and from level 3 you can spend Sorcery Points to cast Darkness that you can see through.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when reduced to 0 HP by most damage you may make a Charisma save to drop to 1 HP instead.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.description: Spend Sorcery Points to summon a shadowy hound that hunts a target and weakens its saves against your spells.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: In dim light or darkness, teleport long distances to another shadowy spot as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: Spend Sorcery Points to become shadowy for 1 minute, resisting most damage and moving through objects.

name: Divine Soul
summary: Wield magic granted by a divine spark
description: A Sorcerer with divine heritage who can draw on the Cleric spell list.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: You can learn spells from the Cleric list as Sorcerer spells and gain an affinity spell based on your divine origin.

options.name: Good
options.description: Learn Cure Wounds.

options.name: Evil
options.description: Learn Inflict Wounds.

options.name: Law
options.description: Learn Bless.

options.name: Chaos
options.description: Learn Bane.

options.name: Neutrality
options.description: Learn Protection from Evil and Good.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, add 2d4 to a failed save or missed attack.

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.description: Spend a Sorcery Point to reroll healing dice for you or a nearby ally.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.description: As a Bonus Action manifest spectral wings and gain a Fly Speed.

features.name: Unearthly Recovery
features.description: Once per Long Rest, when below half HP, regain half your maximum HP as a Bonus Action.

name: Storm Sorcery
summary: Command wind and lightning
description: A Sorcerer whose magic comes from elemental storms, riding gusts as they cast.

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.description: You speak Primordial and its dialects.

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.description: Before or after casting a level 1+ spell, fly a short distance as a Bonus Action without provoking.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.description: You resist Lightning and Thunder, and casting such spells shocks creatures around you.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.description: You can calm rain around you or steer the wind.

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.description: When hit in melee, your Reaction deals Lightning damage to the attacker and can hurl it away.

features.name: Wind Soul
features.description: You become immune to Lightning and Thunder, gain a Fly Speed, and can share flight with allies briefly.

name: The Hexblade
summary: Pact with a sentient weapon from the Shadowfell
description: A Warlock bound to a mysterious entity of living weapons, fighting in melee with Charisma.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Adds the listed spells to your Warlock spell list (under 2024 rules many tables treat them as always prepared).

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: As a Bonus Action curse a creature for 1 minute: add your Proficiency Bonus to damage against it, crit it on 19–20, and heal when it dies; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: Gain Medium armor, Shield and Martial weapon proficiency, and use Charisma for attacks with one bonded weapon.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: When you slay a humanoid, raise its spirit as a specter servant until your next Long Rest; once per Long Rest.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: When your cursed target hits you, roll a d6; on 4+ the attack misses.

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.description: When your cursed target dies, move the curse to another creature nearby (without the healing).

name: The Genie
summary: Serve a noble genie for elemental power
description: A Warlock whose patron is a genie, carrying a vessel that grants refuge and elemental wrath.

features.name: Genie Kind
features.description: Choose your patron's kind, which sets your damage type, resistance and bonus spells.

options.name: Dao
options.description: Earth genie: Bludgeoning wrath; bonus spells Sanctuary, Spike Growth, Meld into Stone, Stone Shape, Wall of Stone.

options.name: Djinni
options.description: Air genie: Thunder wrath; bonus spells Thunderwave, Gust of Wind, Wind Wall, Greater Invisibility, Seeming.

options.name: Efreeti
options.description: Fire genie: Fire wrath; bonus spells Burning Hands, Scorching Ray, Fireball, Fire Shield, Flame Strike.

options.name: Marid
options.description: Water genie: Cold wrath; bonus spells Fog Cloud, Blur, Sleet Storm, Control Water, Cone of Cold.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Every Genie warlock adds these spells, plus the kind-specific ones.

features.name: Genie's Vessel
features.description: A tiny vessel serves as your focus; you can retreat inside it for a few hours, and once per turn add your Proficiency Bonus as extra damage of your genie's type.

features.name: Elemental Gift
features.description: Gain Resistance to your genie's damage type, and briefly fly as a Bonus Action; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Sanctuary Vessel
features.description: Bring up to five willing creatures into your vessel, where a short rest takes only 10 minutes and heals more.

features.name: Limited Wish
features.description: Once every few Long Rests, duplicate the effect of a level 6 or lower spell from any list without components.

name: The Fathomless
summary: Pact with a power of the ocean depths
description: A Warlock bound to a deep-sea entity, wielding a spectral tentacle and the crushing cold of the abyss.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Adds the listed spells to your Warlock spell list.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deeps
features.description: As a Bonus Action summon a spectral tentacle for 1 minute that lashes foes with Cold damage and slows them; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Gift of the Sea
features.description: You gain a Swim Speed and can breathe underwater.

features.name: Oceanic Soul
features.description: You resist Cold damage and can communicate with any creature while both of you are submerged.

features.name: Guardian Coil
features.description: Your tentacle can use your Reaction to reduce damage to a creature near it.

features.name: Grasping Tentacles
features.description: You learn Black Tentacles, can cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, gain temporary HP when you cast it, and damage can't break your Concentration on it.

features.name: Fathomless Plunge
features.description: Teleport yourself and several allies to a body of water you've seen up to a mile away; once per Short or Long Rest.

name: The Undying
summary: Pact with a being that has cheated death
description: A Warlock who learns the secrets of defying death from an immortal patron.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Adds the listed spells to your Warlock spell list.

features.name: Among the Dead
features.description: You learn Spare the Dying, resist disease, and undead hesitate to attack you.

features.name: Defy Death
features.description: Regain some HP when you succeed on a death save or stabilize someone; once per Long Rest.

features.name: Undying Nature
features.description: You need little air, food, water or sleep and age slowly.

features.name: Indestructible Life
features.description: As a Bonus Action regain HP and reattach severed parts; once per Short or Long Rest.

name: Bladesinging
summary: Blend swordplay and spellcraft
description: A Wizard who fights with a blade in an elegant, magic-fueled dance.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.description: Gain Light armor proficiency, proficiency with one one-handed melee weapon, and the Performance skill.

features.name: Bladesong
features.description: As a Bonus Action start a 1-minute Bladesong: add Int to AC and Concentration saves, gain speed and Acrobatics Advantage; uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice with the Attack action, and replace one attack with a cantrip.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.description: While Bladesong is active, use your Reaction and a slot to reduce damage by five times the slot level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.description: While Bladesong is active, add your Int modifier to melee weapon damage.

name: War Magic
summary: Blend evocation and abjuration for the battlefield
description: A Wizard trained for war, deflecting harm and storing power for destructive spells.

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.description: When hit or failing a save, use your Reaction to gain +2 AC or +4 to the save, then cast only cantrips until your next turn ends.

features.name: Tactical Wit
features.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative.

features.name: Power Surge
features.description: You store power surges (gained by countering or dispelling magic) and spend one to add Force damage to a spell.

features.name: Durable Magic
features.description: While concentrating on a spell, gain +2 AC and +2 to saves.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud
features.description: Arcane Deflection also strikes up to three nearby creatures with Force damage.

name: Order of Scribes
summary: Awaken your spellbook
description: A Wizard whose spellbook is a living, aware tome and whose quill writes spells swiftly.

features.name: Wizardly Quill
features.description: Summon a magical quill that copies spells into your book quickly and erases writing.

features.name: Awakened Spellbook
features.description: Your spellbook is your focus; you can swap a spell's damage type to one from another spell of the same level, and cast a ritual quickly once per Long Rest.

features.name: Manifest Mind
features.description: Project your book's spectral mind to sense through it and cast spells from its location a few times per Long Rest.

features.name: Master Scrivener
features.description: After a Long Rest, create a special scroll of a low-level spell from your book that casts at a higher level.

features.name: One with the Word
features.description: You have Advantage on Arcana checks, and you can protect yourself from damage by sacrificing spells from your book for a while.

name: Chronurgy Magic
summary: Manipulate the flow of time
description: A Wizard who bends time, forcing rerolls and freezing creatures in place.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.description: Use your Reaction to force a creature to reroll an attack, check or save; twice per Long Rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative.

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.description: As an action, a creature must save or be frozen in time until your next turn; uses equal Int modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.description: When casting a low-level spell, store it in a bead that you or another creature can release later; once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Convergent Future
features.description: Use your Reaction to decide whether a creature's roll succeeds or fails, at the cost of a level of Exhaustion.

name: Graviturgy Magic
summary: Bend gravity to your will
description: A Wizard who manipulates weight and gravity, pulling foes and crushing them.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.description: As an action, halve or double a creature or object's weight for 1 minute, changing its speed and strength.

features.name: Gravity Well
features.description: When you cast a spell on a creature, you can shift it 5 feet.

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.description: Use your Reaction to boost a nearby weapon hit or a fall's damage; uses equal Int modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Event Horizon
features.description: Create a 1-minute gravitational field that damages and pins hostile creatures; once per Long Rest or spend a level 3+ slot.
